events.label: Killing of Jean Charles de Menezes at Stockwell underground station
Metropolitan Police Commissioner Ian Blair resigns following political pressure
Death of Ian Tomlinson at G20 protests; PC Simon Harwood under investigation
England riots and shooting of Mark Duggan; phone-hacking scandal rocks the Met
Hillsborough panel confirms cover-up; elected Police and Crime Commissioners; “Plebgate”
Public confidence in the police reaches its peak (ONS Crime Survey)
Terror attacks including Manchester Arena and London Bridge; Grenfell Tower fire
Murder of George Floyd sparks UK protests and renewed scrutiny of policing
Murder of Sarah Everard by serving Metropolitan Police officer Wayne Couzens
Charing Cross sexism and racism scandal; Child Q strip-search inquiry; David Carrick serial rape convictions
Casey Review finds the Metropolitan Police institutionally racist, misogynistic and homophobic
Vetting and misconduct reforms; record 695 officer dismissals

milestones.label: Facebook launches
milestones.detail: The dominant social network is founded (Feb 2004).

milestones.label: Facebook News Feed
milestones.detail: The algorithmic feed that organises what users see is introduced (5 Sep 2006).

milestones.label: Facebook 'Like' button
milestones.detail: A lightweight engagement signal that begins to drive ranking (Feb 2009).

milestones.label: Twitter algorithmic timeline
milestones.detail: Twitter switches from chronological to engagement-ranked (Feb 2016).

milestones.label: Facebook 'Meaningful Social Interactions'
milestones.detail: A reranking later reported to have boosted divisive, anger-laden content (WSJ 'Facebook Files', 2021).

milestones.label: George Floyd video goes viral
milestones.detail: A bystander video spreads globally within days, intensifying scrutiny of policing (25 May 2020).
